description: Claude Code prompt usage per engineer, from OTel log events.

links.title: Claude Working Time
links.tooltip: How long Claude Code worked for each engineer, per repository and workday. That dashboard uses your browser's timezone where this one uses UTC, so a relative range such as Today covers your local day there

panels.description: Number of distinct engineers (by email, or user key when no email is reported) who sent at least one Claude Code prompt in the selected time range. Respects the Project, OTel team, Engineer and Repository filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)) AS "AI Engineers"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.description: Total estimated cost (USD) of prompts divided by the number of distinct engineers who sent them, for the selected time range and filters. Cost is the sum of the per-request cost Claude Code reports, not billed spend.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)), 0) AS "Cost per Engineer"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Cost per Engineer

panels.description: Share of engineers with at least one prompt that used a skill, out of all engineers who sent prompts in the selected time range and filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(e.used_skill) AS "Engineers Using Skills"
FROM (
  SELECT MAX(p.used_skill) AS used_skill
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)
) e

panels.title: Engineers Using Skills

panels.description: One row per engineer for each model (or combination of models), reasoning effort and permission mode they used, with prompts, distinct sessions, estimated cost (USD), cost per prompt, the share of prompts that used a skill or were slash commands, and failed tool calls as a share of all tool calls. Engineers without a DevLake account name are shown by email, and mode 'Agentic' is Claude Code's default permission mode. Model 'N/A' means the prompt made no model request (such as a local slash command), and effort 'N/A' means no request reported an effort.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS "Engineer",
  u.team AS "Team",
  u.model AS "Model",
  u.effort AS "Effort",
  u.mode AS "Mode",
  u.prompts AS "Prompts",
  u.sessions AS "Sessions",
  u.cost AS "Cost",
  u.cost / u.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  u.skill_share AS "Used a skill",
  u.command_share AS "Slash command",
  u.tool_failure_rate AS "Tool failure rate"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    CASE WHEN p.models_used = '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') END AS model,
    CASE p.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(p.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(p.effort, 2)), 'N/A') END AS effort,
    CASE WHEN p.permission_mode = 'default' AND p.permission_mode_inferred = 1 THEN 'Not reported (assumed default)' WHEN p.permission_mode = 'default' THEN 'Default' WHEN p.permission_mode = 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN p.permission_mode = 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN p.permission_mode = 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN p.permission_mode = 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE p.permission_mode END AS mode,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.team_slug ORDER BY c.team_slug SEPARATOR ', ') AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    AVG(p.used_skill) AS skill_share,
    AVG(p.command_name <> '') AS command_share,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0), 0) AS tool_failure_rate
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = p.source_connection_id
  -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
  -- another account with the same email.
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
) u
ORDER BY 1, u.prompts DESC

panels.title: Claude Usage by Engineers

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;

list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;

list.definition:
-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u
ORDER BY 1;

list.definition:
-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
